mapper.sql: barcode_id, barcode_format, barcode_type, barcode_content, biz_id, biz_code, biz_name, barcode_url, enable_flag, del_flag, remark
mapper.select: select from wm_barcode where barcode_id = #{barcodeId} and del_flag = '0'
select from wm_barcode where barcode_content = #{barcodeContent} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into wm_barcode (barcode_format, barcode_type, barcode_content, biz_id, biz_code, biz_name, barcode_url, enable_flag, del_flag, remark) values (#{barcodeFormat}, #{barcodeType}, #{barcodeContent}, #{bizId}, #{bizCode}, #{bizName}, #{barcodeUrl}, 'Y', '0', #{remark})
